items.title: Helping caregivers use AI in everyday life
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI Academy is bringing free, hands-on ChatGPT workshops to caregivers in five U.S. cities, helping them build practical AI skills for everyday life.

items.lead_paragraph: New research from OpenAI and Upwork finds shifting demand for freelance work, new skill combinations, and larger budgets and more hours for AI-related projects.

items.title: ChatGPT Enterprise now available in AWS Marketplace
items.lead_paragraph: ChatGPT Enterprise is now available through AWS Marketplace, helping organizations simplify procurement through existing AWS purchasing and billing relationships.

items.title: Control Room: A central system to track and stop model workloads across our research infrastructure
items.lead_paragraph: Learn how OpenAI’s Control Room tracks model workloads across our research infrastructure and can rapidly stop them when safety or security concerns arise.

items.title: CodeRabbit scales agentic software development and ships 20x more
items.lead_paragraph: CodeRabbit uses OpenAI models to govern and trust AI-generated code and Codex to ship 20 times more software with the same engineering team.

items.title: Kuken Industries searches 70 years of drawings in minutes
items.lead_paragraph: Kuken Industries uses the OpenAI API to search 70 years of cooling tower drawings. Engineers can find the drawing for a repair in 4.5 minutes, down from nearly an hour.

items.title: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI is partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities, test connections with third-party services, and strengthen defenses with frontier AI.

items.title: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI introduces BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark measuring how well AI agents interpret raw experimental data and handle everyday wet-lab science.

items.title: Australian universities are creating AI-native graduates
items.lead_paragraph: Australian universities are expanding access to ChatGPT and bringing AI into teaching and learning to prepare students for an AI-enabled workforce.

items.title: Cult.fit builds operational muscle with Codex
items.lead_paragraph: Cult.fit is using Codex to help teams across functions build tools, move faster, and change how work gets done.

items.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
items.lead_paragraph: Introducing GPT‑6 Cyber, OpenAI’s cybersecurity model for finding exploitable vulnerabilities and developing fixes, trained to stay within authorized scope.

items.title: Merge builds product and business tools with OpenAI technology
items.lead_paragraph: Merge uses GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT, and Codex to review product code and support marketing. Its teams also use AI to plan executive dinners and prepare sales updates.

items.title: Setting a new standard for responsible AI infrastructure
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI introduces its National Community Compact and Compute Campus Policy Blueprint to protect local resources, create jobs, and guide responsible AI infrastructure development.

items.title: Flipsnack grows product signups with conversion optimization
items.lead_paragraph: Flipsnack focused its ChatGPT Ads campaigns on getting people to try its product, growing registrations while lowering the cost per signup.

items.title: Franklin Templeton uses OpenAI to support investment research
items.lead_paragraph: Starting with equity research, Franklin Templeton is developing AI workflows to help portfolio managers compare research views and examine investment risks.

items.title: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc.
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI will acquire Pierre Computer Company, expanding Codex’s tools for building, understanding, and reviewing code.

items.title: Daybreak Red is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-East)
items.lead_paragraph: Daybreak Red brings GPT-5.6 Cyber to approved customers in AWS GovCloud (US-East) through Amazon Bedrock for authorized cybersecurity work.
